name: Kurama Hiro
source:
"If I'm not needed anymore, than peace isn't needed anymore either."

The youngest member of the SRX team, a well read boy.
He has a reserved, shy, personality and has a hard time communicating with others.
Because of that he tries to drive away people with sharp words, but he can be really sweet to his real friends.
He doesn't have much confidence in his ability as an SRX member and is afraid he is holding everyone back.
He plays drums for the Odd-I's band.
His partner Substance is [url=/c30013]Duesenberg[/url].
